title: Production manual admission authority and sender lifecycle

conditions.description: Provide reviewed production same-snapshot capacity policy, complete writer/occupancy baseline and trusted freshness/role evidence, authenticated original-bound reservation and pre-send/definite-no-send lifecycle for manual browser ingress. Current ProjectCapacityAdmission and inventory baseline are explicitly disposable fixtures; NativeProjectEffectTransition identity binds scheduler Worker/Reviewer account effects rather than manual browser launches. Identify canonical producer APIs and owned source leases. Keep production HOLD until established.
conditions.evidence: Adjudicator 1 checkpoint 15059 cross-references the accepted W14/W16/W21 design contracts but explicitly preserves production HOLD and authorizes no corrective source work. W14 docs/project-capacity-policy-producer-worker14.md says the policy component is default-off and unregistered; policy read, even within a same-CAS callback, is not an inventory baseline, proof of complete writer coverage, observation time, reservation, or accounting for uncertain effects. W16 docs/project-launch-inventory-authority-worker16.md says no sender is fenced and no baseline/occupancy/admission/release authority is established; Client/SignalR/Client.fs manual BrowserRunInNewTab and Client/Program.fs scheduled launch are separate paths; ReviewWorkflow/FeedbackStore liveness is advisory/resettable; complete sender barrier, trusted issuer and original-bound no-send evidence are absent. W21 Client.ProjectCapacityAdmission explicitly says default-off, no production bootstrap, trusted role binder, effect issuer or send path; its disposable state is test-only. W21 ProjectCapacityDispatchTransition returns Committed/Replay preparation outcomes, neither of which authorizes a provider call. W23 review d1ef4bb2b28b4f1784cfeda28405003b remains ChangesRequested; adjudication narrowed the finding to the missing explicit producer-contract cross-reference, not production authority. Ownership is distinct: W14 policy producer; W16 inventory/baseline; W21 same-CAS admission and original-bound pre-send exclusion; W23 manual SignalR caller; W19 scheduled Program caller and shared Client.fsproj registration; W12 account-side authority. W23 may continue only the existing default-off/disposable scope; do not infer production admission or live sender authority from fixture tests.
conditions.reason: The requested production authority does not exist in the inspected source. Current artifacts establish only default-off, disposable planning and design contracts; they do not prove a complete sender barrier, trusted historical occupancy issuer, same-snapshot production inventory/policy, or manual-browser original-bound terminal/no-send authority. Positive production admission must remain HOLD. Reopen only when the source owners provide exact independently reviewed and integrated evidence.
